subject: Timeline & export options for tenant access records — compliance checklist
messages:
From: Oliver Miles <oliver.miles@medalign.com>

Cc: compliance@medalign.com
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Tenant access records - export & retention questions

Hi Aisha,

We're preparing for an external audit in Q1 and need to lock down how tenant access traces / audit logs are retained and what formats and timelines we can get an export in. Key questions from our compliance team:

- What are the default retention windows for access/audit logs for EU tenants (hot vs cold storage)?
- Can we request a one-off bulk export for a time window (e.g., 2025-01-01 to 2026-11-30)?
- Export formats supported (ndjson, parquet, CSV)? Any manifest or indexed delivery?
- Is cross-border export allowed if we request an archive copy (we need to hand data to our auditors in Ireland)?
- What SLAs and lead times do you recommend (notice period, staging, checksum/manifest)?

We want the answers in writing for our internal control book. If you have a checklist we can complete to start the export request, please share.

Thanks,
Oliver Miles
Head of Risk & Compliance
MedAlign Health

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Neha from Product to add the technical specifics; below is a short summary to start and a checklist attachment (redwood-export-form.pdf) you can use to capture scope.

Quick summary (high level):
- Default retention (EU tenants): 90 days indexed/hot; optional extended retention up to 13 months in cold archive (configurable per-account).
- Bulk exports: yes — we support ad-hoc bulk exports for arbitrary windows. We produce an indexed export + manifest.
- Formats: ndjson (line-delimited JSON) and Parquet are standard; CSV is possible for small slices but not recommended for full traces.
- Cross-border: exports can be delivered to any destination you nominate, but cross-border exports require the executed DPA + export approval form.
- Timeline & SLA: typical turnaround is 7–10 business days for exports < 1TB; 10–20 business days for larger archives. We provide a delivery manifest and SHA256 checksums.

I've attached the export request checklist. Neha — can you confirm the default retention tiers and whether we have a hard cap on maximum export window for EU tenants?

Next steps for MedAlign: fill the attached form with the time range and destination, then we'll confirm schedule and the manifest template.

Best,
Aisha Rahman

Hi all — adding concrete details for the control book: useful to paste into your SOC file.

Retention specifics (EU tenant):
- Hot (searchable) window: 90 days by default.
- Warm/cold archive: up to 13 months (392 days) if the customer has enabled extended retention.
- Deletion workflow: deletions are tombstoned and removed from hot within the configured TTL; full physical purge from archives runs on a monthly cycle and is auditable.

Export capabilities:
- Supported export formats: ndjson (preferred), Apache Parquet (columnar, recommended for large datasets). We also provide gzipped bundles for exports.
- Index & manifest: exports include a CSV manifest with byte offsets, a human-readable index, and SHA256 checksums.
- Time-range limits: no technical cap on historical window if data exists; practical limit is governed by data volume and retention policy (if a tenant did not enable extended retention earlier, older traces may no longer exist).
- Delivery: S3-compatible signed URL(s), encrypted transfer to an endpoint you own, or on-prem delivery via our enterprise handoff process.
- Cross-border: permitted when DPA is in place; export request must include destination region and intended recipient. If destination keys are customer-managed (KMS/HSM), include the public key in the form.

Operational timeline guidance:
- Small exports (<200GB): 5–8 business days after form & approvals.
- Medium (200GB–2TB): 8–15 business days.
- Large (>2TB): 15–30 business days with a 48-hour staging window for verification.

Attachment note: redwood-export-form.pdf includes the manifest template and KMS info.

Neha Kapoor
Sr Product Manager, Platform & Compliance

Oliver — confirmed:
- We will provide the export manifest template (attached: export-manifest-template.csv) and the delivery will include per-file SHA256 checksums and the index file.
- Ireland-based S3 delivery is supported; please send the destination bucket + IAM role or presigned PUT details via the completed export form.
- Extended retention is a configurable account option and is billed as an add-on to storage; enabling it retroactively will only surface traces that were actually retained.

Estimated ETA for 1.1TB (given current queue): 12 business days from the date we receive the completed form and delivery credentials. We will also provide a staging URL 24–48 hours prior to final delivery for your auditor verification.
